target=tools/focused_engine_tests.zig
expected_head=517a53855356a5226aa222e2860ed9274c70a61f
export HOME_RUN_MAX_MB=3072
export HOME_RUN_LOCK=/Users/glennmichaeltorregosa/.cache/home-run.lock
export HOME_RUN_LABEL=codex-989-follow-up-retry

cd "$repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$expected_head"
test "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" = " M $target"
git diff --check -- "$target"
before_hash=$(git diff --binary -- "$target" | shasum -a 256 | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
stash_before=$(git rev-parse -q --verify refs/stash 2>/dev/null || true)
git stash push -m codex-986-tsan-witness-during-989-evidence -- "$target" > "$root/stash-save.log"
stash_after=$(git rev-parse -q --verify refs/stash)
test "$stash_after" != "$stash_before"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"

restore() {
  status=$?
  trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP
  git stash pop > "$root/stash-restore.log" 2>&1
  test "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" = " M $target"
  after_hash=$(git diff --binary -- "$target" | shasum -a 256 | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
  test "$after_hash" = "$before_hash"
  exit "$status"
}

done
